## Loading the data

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
workingdir = "../STREAMLINE/outputs/" #the "output" folder of BEELINE/STREAMLINE

postproc <- function(data, networks, directed, type){
  if(nrow(data) == 0) return(data)
  
  algo_levels = c("GRNBOOST2", "INFERELATOR", "GENIE3")
  if(!directed){algo_levels = c(algo_levels, "PIDC", "PPCOR", "hdWGCNA", "BORDA", "mBORDA", "sBORDA", "smBORDA")}
  if(type=="raw"){algo_levels = c(algo_levels, "ground truth")}
  
  data$Algorithm <- factor(data$Algorithm, levels=algo_levels)
  
  if(networks=="experimental"){
    # Experimental networks are flat and have specific names
    data$Network <- factor(data$Network, levels=c("ESC", "hHep"))
  } else {
    # Curated networks have the 12 subgroups (Summarized across replicates)
    expected <- c("GSD-200", "GSD-1000", "GSD-2000",
                  "HSC-200", "HSC-1000", "HSC-2000",
                  "mCAD-200", "mCAD-1000", "mCAD-2000",
                  "VSC-200", "VSC-1000", "VSC-2000")
    data$Network <- factor(data$Network, levels=intersect(expected, unique(data$Network)))
  }
  
  if("Shortest Path Length" %in% colnames(data)){
    colnames(data)[colnames(data) == 'Shortest Path Length'] <- 'Avg Shortest Path Length'
  }
  return(data)
}

STREAMLINE_results <- function(networks = "Curated", type, directed, add_dataset=FALSE){
  
  read_file <- function(datadir, is_curated, directed, type) {
    str_dir = ifelse(directed, "directed", "undirected")
    str_mode = ifelse(type %in% c("raw", "mse", "mse_rel"), "global", "local")
    path <- file.path(datadir, paste0("STREAMLINE_", str_mode, "_", str_dir, "_", type, ".csv"))
    
    if (file.exists(path)) {
      df <- read.csv(path, check.names=FALSE)
      if(nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
      colnames(df)[1] <- "Algorithm"
      
      if(is_curated){
        # Strip replicate ID (GSD-200-1 -> GSD-200)
        df$Network <- sub("-[0-9]+$", "", basename(datadir))
      } else {
        # Keep name as is (yeast, hESC, etc)
        df$Network <- basename(datadir)
      }
      return(df)
    }
    return(NULL)
  }

  base_path <- paste0(workingdir, networks)
  
  if(networks == "Curated"){
    # Curated: Look for subgroup folders that contain replicates (folders with dashes and numbers)
    all_dirs <- list.dirs(base_path, recursive = TRUE)
    target_dirs <- all_dirs[grepl("-[0-9]+$", basename(all_dirs))]
    df_list <- lapply(target_dirs, read_file, is_curated=TRUE, directed=directed, type=type)
  } else {
    # Experimental: Look only at the top-level folders inside 'experimental'
    target_dirs <- list.dirs(base_path, recursive = FALSE)
    df_list <- lapply(target_dirs, read_file, is_curated=FALSE, directed=directed, type=type)
  }
  
  combined <- bind_rows(df_list)
  if(nrow(combined) == 0) stop("No data found for: ", networks)
  
  return(postproc(combined, networks, directed, type))
}
load_performance_data <- function(metric, networks, directed){
  if (directed){ str_directed = "directed" } else {str_directed = "undirected"}
  if(networks == "Curated"){datasets= c("GSD", "HSC", "mCAD", "VSC")}
  else if(networks == "experimental"){datasets = c("ESC", "hHep")}
  read_file <- function(dataset, networks, metric, directed) {
    data <- read.csv(paste0(workingdir, networks, "/", dataset, "/", dataset, "-", metric, "-", directed, ".csv"), row.names="X")
    raw_wide <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(t(data)), var = "Dataset")
    raw <- pivot_longer(raw_wide, cols=2:ncol(raw_wide), names_to="Algorithm", values_to = metric,)
    raw_meta <- cbind(raw, dataset)
    colnames(raw_meta)[4] <- "Network"
    return(raw_meta)
  }
  df_list = lapply(datasets, read_file, networks=networks, metric=metric, directed=str_directed)
  data <- bind_rows(df_list)
  data <- postproc(data, networks, directed, metric)
  return(data)
}
```

## General figure utilities

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
out_dir <- "./outputs_graphics/groups/" #directory to save image outputs
in_dir <- "../Figures/input/" #directory for required external images

# Updated Palettes
algo_palette = c("#37437C", "#F5E90F", "#9F5E45", "#407346", "#833B38", "#2ebebe", "#be2ebe", "#be842e", "#085e22", "grey")
exp_network_palette = brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Set1")
syn_network_palette = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Set2"))(12) # 12 colors for Curated

# Option B: Grouped colors - 3 shades of Green for GSD, 3 shades of Blue for HSC, etc.
# syn_network_palette <- c(brewer.pal(3, "Greens"), brewer.pal(3, "Blues"), 
#                          brewer.pal(3, "Oranges"), brewer.pal(3, "Purples"))

savepdf <- function(plot, name, w, h){
  ggsave(paste0(out_dir, name, ".pdf"), plot, device = "pdf", width = w, height = h, units = "in", dpi = 300) }

plot_metric <- function(metric, data, plot, x="Algorithm", ylab=NULL, no_legend=FALSE, palette=NULL){
  
  scale_x_network = function(...){scale_x_discrete(limits= sort(unique(data$Network)), ...)}
  scale_x_algo <- function(...){scale_x_discrete(limits= sort(unique(data$Algorithm)), ...)}
  
  if (plot =="sina"){
    panel <- ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[metric]], color = Network)) + geom_sina(na.rm = TRUE) + theme_pubr() + 
      scale_colour_manual(values = palette, labels= sort(unique(data$Network))) + theme(legend.text=element_text(size=rel(1.2)), 
      legend.key.size=unit(1, 'cm'), legend.title=element_text(size=rel(1.2))) + stat_summary(fun.y=median, geom="crossbar", size=.1) +labs(y=metric)
    if(x=="Algorithm"){panel <- panel + scale_x_algo(guide = guide_axis(angle = 45))}
    else if(x=="Network") { 
      panel <- panel + scale_x_network()
      if(metric=="In Centralization"){panel <- panel + scale_y_log10() + ylab("log10(In Centralization)")}
    }
  } 
  if(plot %in% c("ji", "ji_ratio")){
    #mean_data <- aggregate(. ~ Algorithm + Network, data=data, FUN=mean)
    #se_data <- aggregate(. ~ Algorithm + Network, data=data, FUN=function(x){sd(x)/sqrt(length(x))})
    mean_data <- aggregate(as.formula(paste(metric, "~ Algorithm + Network")), data=data, FUN=mean, na.rm=TRUE, na.action=na.pass)
    se_data <- aggregate(as.formula(paste(metric, "~ Algorithm + Network")), data=data, FUN=function(x){sd(x, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(sum(!is.na(x)))}, na.action=na.pass)
    data1 <- data.frame("Algorithm"=mean_data$Algorithm, "Network"=mean_data$Network, "Mean"=mean_data[,metric], "Se"=se_data[,metric])
    
    panel <- ggplot(data1, aes(x=Network, y=Mean, color = Algorithm)) + scale_color_manual(values=algo_palette) +
      geom_point( position=position_dodge(0.5))+  theme_pubr() +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=Mean-Se, ymax=Mean+Se), width=.5,  position=position_dodge(0.5)) +
      ggtitle(metric) + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
      scale_x_network() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) # rotate x labels

    if(plot=="ji_ratio"){
        panel <- panel + geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color="red", linetype="solid", size=0.7) + labs(y= expression(J / J["rand"]))
    }
  }
  if(plot == "heatmap"){
    data <- select(data, -Dataset)
    median_data <- aggregate(as.formula(paste(metric, "~ Algorithm + Network")), data=data, FUN=function(x) as.numeric(median(x, na.rm = TRUE)), na.action=na.pass)
    #median_data <- aggregate(. ~ Algorithm + Network, data=data, FUN=function(x) as.numeric(median(x, na.rm = TRUE)))
    if(metric == "EPr"){median_data[metric] <- median_data[metric]*100}
    panel <- ggplot(median_data, aes(x = Network, y = Algorithm, fill = .data[[metric]])) + theme_pubr() +
      geom_tile(color = "white", lwd = .5, linetype = 1) + scale_fill_gradient2(low="white", high="blue") +
      geom_text(aes(label = round(.data[[metric]], 2)), color = ifelse(median_data[metric] >0.6, "white", "black"), size = 4) + 
      scale_colour_manual(values=c("white"="white", "black"="black")) +
      theme(legend.position="right") + coord_fixed() +
      scale_x_network() + scale_y_discrete(limits= rev(sort(unique(data$Algorithm))))
    if(metric == "EPr"){panel <- panel + labs(fill= expression(paste("EPr x", 10^{-2})))}
  }
  if(plot == "bar"){
    panel <- ggbarplot(data, x = "Network", y = metric, fill = "Algorithm",
                      add = "mean_se", palette = algo_palette,
                      position = position_dodge(0.5), na.rm = TRUE) + ggtitle(metric) + 
                      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
                      scale_x_network()
  } 
  if (plot =="violin"){
    panel <- ggviolin(data, x = x, y = metric, fill = "Network", 
                      palette = palette, draw_quantiles = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
                      labs(y=metric) + ggtitle(metric) + 
                      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
                      scale_x_network()
    if(x=="Algorithm"){
      panel <- panel + scale_x_algo(guide = guide_axis(angle = 45)) + geom_vline(xintercept=4.5, linetype="dotted")
    }
    else if(x=="Network"){
      panel <- panel + scale_x_network()
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(ylab)) {panel = panel + labs(y=ylab)}
  if (no_legend) {panel = panel + theme(legend.position="none")}
  return(panel)
}

metric_row <- function(metrics, plot, networks, type, directed,  x="Algorithm", ylab=NULL, ncol=length(metrics), algos=NULL){
  data = STREAMLINE_results(networks=networks, type=type, directed=directed)
  if(!is.null(algos)){data = data[data$Algorithm %in% algos, ]}
  if(networks=="Curated"){palette=syn_network_palette} else if(networks=="experimental"){palette=exp_network_palette}
  row_plots <- lapply(metrics, plot_metric, data=data, plot=plot, x=x, ylab=ylab, no_legend=TRUE, palette=palette)
  row <- plot_grid(plotlist=row_plots, ncol = ncol)
}

syn_data = STREAMLINE_results(networks="Curated", type="raw", directed=FALSE)
syn_network_legend <- get_legend(plot_metric("Assortativity", data=syn_data, plot="violin", palette=syn_network_palette))

exp_data = STREAMLINE_results(networks="experimental", type="raw", directed=FALSE)
exp_network_legend <- get_legend(plot_metric("Assortativity", data=exp_data, plot="sina", palette=exp_network_palette))

syn_data = STREAMLINE_results(networks="Curated", type="mse", directed=FALSE)
undir_algo_legend <- get_legend(plot_metric("Assortativity", data=syn_data, plot="bar"))

syn_data = STREAMLINE_results(networks="Curated", type="mse", directed=TRUE)
dir_algo_legend <- get_legend(plot_metric("Assortativity", data=syn_data, plot="bar"))
```


## Figure 2 + 3

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
figures2_3_curated <- function(metrics, name){
  
  # 1. Row: Simple Title Generation
  plot_title <- function(title){ 
    return(ggplot() + ggtitle(title) + theme_void() + 
           theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face="bold", size = 14)))
  }
  
  # Create a row of titles based on the number of metrics provided
  # Using a dynamic approach to handle single or multiple metrics
  title_list <- lapply(metrics, plot_title)
  title_row <- do.call(plot_grid, c(title_list, ncol = length(metrics)))
  
  # 2. Row: Curated Results Only
  # The metric_row function already returns the assembled plot for the specified network
  row_curated <- metric_row(metrics, plot="bar", networks = "Curated", 
                            type="mse", ylab="MSE", directed=FALSE)

  # 3. Assembly
  # We only need the Title, the Data (Row B), and the Legend
  figure <- plot_grid(
    title_row, 
    row_curated, 
    undir_algo_legend, 
    ncol = 1, 
    rel_heights = c(0.1, 0.8, 0.5) # Adjust these ratios to fit your page
  )
  
  print(figure)
  savepdf(figure, name, w=10, h=6)
  return(figure)
}

for (metric in c("Global Efficiency", "Local Efficiency", "Avg Shortest Path Length")){
  figure2 <- figures2_3_curated(metrics = c(metric), name = paste0("figure2_", metric))
  ggsave(filename = paste0(out_dir, "figure2_", metric, ".png"), 
         plot = figure2, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
}

for (metric in c("Assortativity", "Clustering Coefficient", "Centralization")){
  figure3 <- figures2_3_curated(metrics=c(metric), name=paste("figure3_",metric, sep="_"))
  ggsave(filename = paste0(out_dir, "figure3_", metric, ".png"),
    plot = figure3 ,width = 8,height = 5,dpi = 300)
  }
```

## Additional Figure for correlation on node-level of graph-level properties

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
metrics = c("Local Efficiency", "Clustering Coefficient", "Node Degrees")

for (metric in metrics){
  row1 <- metric_row(metrics, plot="bar", networks="Curated", type="correlation", directed=FALSE)
  #row2 <- metric_row(metrics, plot="bar", networks="experimental", type="correlation", directed=FALSE)

  figure <- plot_grid(undir_algo_legend, row1, nrow=2, rel_heights = c(.5, 3), labels=c("", "A"))
  figure
  savepdf(figure, paste0("figureCorr_", metric), w=10, h=6)
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(out_dir, "figureCorr_", metric, ".png"),
    plot = figure,width = 10,height = 6,dpi = 300)
}
```
